hook_text: Down 7, up 9, down 6, up 3. Which floor? Two ways, one answer.
clip_script: The lift: four plus minus seven plus nine plus minus six plus three. Positives: four plus nine plus three is sixteen. Negatives: minus seven plus minus six is minus thirteen. Sixteen plus minus thirteen is three. Left to right: minus three, six, zero, three. They agree.
visual_style: A lift indicator flickers through floors 4, −3, 6, 0, 3; then up-arrows and down-arrows sort into two piles of 16 and 13.
pacing: Lift ride montage, then grouping reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to rearrange any integer sum with confidence.
